bio.text: Frank Lucas represents Oklahoma's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House and was first elected in a 1994 special election.
Born in 1960 in Cheyenne, Oklahoma, he graduated from Oklahoma State University in 1982 with a degree in agricultural economics.
He served about five and a half years in the Oklahoma House of Representatives before Congress, and chaired the House Agriculture Committee from 2011 to 2015.
